# Aslane Samai

> Aslane Samai is an SEO and GEO (generative engine optimization) consultant based in Paris, France. He helps businesses get found on Google and cited in AI answers (ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overviews) through technical SEO audits, data analysis and content. He writes aioseo.fr, a blog about AI search in French and English.

Key facts:

- Name: Aslane Samai (also written Samai Aslane)
- Role: SEO / GEO consultant, based in Paris, France; works in French and English
- Experience:
  - Eskimoz (Sep 2025 – 2026): SEO & GEO consultant. Managed a portfolio of about ten accounts across all sectors and sizes, from SMEs to large accounts such as Sunelia, Manpower, Engie My Power and Riverly. High-volume technical, semantic and GEO audits: crawl and indexing, semantic coverage, authority, citability and citations in generative engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, AI Overviews). Semantic clustering, LLM citation tests, technical and editorial GEO guidelines, SEO briefs, and roadmaps tailored to each client's stack (headless CMS, WordPress, JS frameworks).
  - Voices For Animal Welfare (Oct 2025 – Jan 2026): Head of SEO Analytics. Set up the SEO roadmap and the analytics ecosystem (GA4, Search Console) for the launch of the NGO's website, then led technical optimization and organic link acquisition.
  - aioseo.fr (Apr 2025 – Present): Founder · independent project. I run the whole SEO / GEO lifecycle of aioseo.fr, a GEO watch blog followed by the French SEO community: content, technical SEO, netlinking, and a WordPress stack driven through MCP.
  - Finance Héros (Mar 2025 – Sep 2025): Technical SEO & R&D consultant (internship). A GEO roadmap and a Reddit acquisition strategy, a consolidated SEO / SEA Looker Studio report, and the technical overhaul and performance optimization of a network of sites.
  - RADCO (Aug 2023 – Aug 2024): SEO traffic manager. Redesigned the site architecture, backlink strategy and analytics for a construction company in Algiers. Google visibility went from 0 to 45,000 monthly impressions.
  - MMT · Mobile Medical Team (Mar 2023 – Aug 2024): SEO specialist. SEO audits, website management and backlink acquisition for a mobile medical team in Riyadh.
  - InterFast (Feb 2022 – Mar 2023): SEO content manager. Technical audits and data analysis to prioritize organic work, and management of the digital ecosystem and user engagement campaigns for a construction software company.
  - Unimind (Sep 2021 – Feb 2022): SEO content manager. Technical audits and data analysis to prioritize organic work, and management of the digital ecosystem and user engagement campaigns for a productivity app.
- Education:
  - Université Paris Dauphine – PSL, M2 IREN (Sep 2025 – Sep 2026): Data science and advanced econometrics
  - Université Paris-Saclay, M1 IES (Sep 2024 – Sep 2025): Digital economics, data analysis and web analytics
  - EHEC, M2 Marketing (Jan 2018 – Dec 2021): Digital and strategic marketing, entrepreneurship
  - ESGCI (Sep 2016 – Sep 2018): Preparatory classes: economics, algebra, micro and macroeconomics
- Skills and tools: Technical SEO, Semantic SEO & clustering, SEO & GEO audits, LLM citation tests, Entity optimization, Core Web Vitals, Edge SEO, Netlinking, Content briefs; Screaming Frog, Sitebulb, Oncrawl, Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, Chrome DevTools; Python (pandas), SQL (BigQuery), Ahrefs API, Scraping, sentence-transformers, KeyBERT, TimesFM, Prophet; Google Analytics 4, Looker Studio, Tableau; WordPress, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SSH; French (C2), English (C1)
- Certifications: Google Data Analytics (Google / Coursera), SQL (CoRise), Technical SEO (Blue Array), SEO Manager (Blue Array)
- Tools built (free to use):
  - [Bulk semantic proximity](https://semantic-proximity-analyzer-5ds58ihtyvktcvyxcijrku.streamlit.app): Match your priority keywords with Search Console data and score the semantic proximity of every ranking URL, in bulk.
  - [SEO Entity Analyser](https://seo-entity-checker.streamlit.app/): Extract and check the entities of a page or a whole list of URLs with the GPT API, to see what AI engines understand.
  - [Semantic auditor (URL vs URL)](https://semanticproximity-seo.streamlit.app/): Compare your page with a competitor's for a target query: cosine proximity score and the entities you're missing.
  - [SEO Forecaster · Google TimesFM](https://python-seo-analyzer-xbmrhkkvwav6dvoqsq298c.streamlit.app/): Forecast clicks, impressions, CTR and position from a Search Console export with Google's TimesFM foundation model.
  - [SEO Forecaster · Meta Prophet](https://seoforcastmetapropeht.streamlit.app/): Forecast Search Console traffic with Meta's Prophet: trend, weekly and yearly seasonality, holidays.
  - [Multimodal GEO audit · Gemini-Embedding-2](https://aioseo.fr/audit-geo-multimodal-avec-gemini-embedding-2/): Audit how text, images and video line up with queries using Google's multimodal Gemini-Embedding-2 model.
- Also writes: [aioseo.fr](https://aioseo.fr/) (English: https://aioseo.fr/en/), "AIO SEO · Good GEO is good SEO!", a blog about GEO and AI search in French and English (Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, query fan-out, GEO tools)
- Contact: contact@aslanesamai.com · book a 30-minute call to start an SEO / GEO audit: https://calendly.com/samaiaslane/free-seo-audit
- Profiles: LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/aslane-samai · GitHub https://github.com/aslan04739 · Medium https://medium.com/@samaiaslane7
